elements.label: P&L sheet grid replacing loading spinner

pattern.description: A blank app window with a loading spinner resolves in effectively one frame into the fully populated P&L spreadsheet (toolbar, account rows, monthly columns) inside the same browser frame.
pattern.why_premium: The load is cut down to a near-instant swap so the viewer never waits on a real spinner; the window chrome stays fixed, so the data appears to land in place and continuity is kept.

build_hint.gsap: Keep the window frame static. tl.set(spinner, {autoAlpha: 0}) then tl.fromTo(sheet, {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.05, ease: 'none'}) - essentially a hard swap timed just after the narration pause.
build_hint.remotion: Render the spinner until the event frame, then switch to the sheet layer; optionally opacity: interpolate(frame, [f0, f0 + 1], [0, 1], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}).

notes: Screen-recorded page load; the change is a near-instant swap (energy peak in one frame), not an authored animation. skeleton_resolve is the closest canonical match (spinner rather than skeleton bars).
